item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We know what is at stake: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must stop that future before it becomes irreversible.

2. We refuse to accept a billion deaths as the price of technological progress. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, that catastrophe will follow. We demand action to prevent its development.

3. We stand for a future in which humanity survives. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must prevent it—not race toward it.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe humanity’s future must not be sacrificed to the race for superintelligent AI. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We will not treat those lives as an acceptable cost of innovation, nor accept promises of progress as a reason to ignore the consequences. We demand decisive action to prevent the development of superintelligent AI within that timeframe. Our responsibility is clear: protect human life before this catastrophe becomes irreversible. Together, we must turn that responsibility into public pressure, political resolve, and a firm refusal to gamble with humanity’s survival.
